347:t_1:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Then you have learned Prince $$ユーサー$$'s true intentions?」

347:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. Once the settlement of Mars by the people of $$インサラウム$$ reached a lull, Commander $$マルグリット$$ had something to tell us.」

347:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「When we learned that we had pushed all the blame for the war onto the Prince, we were so consumed by guilt that all of us who had been knights considered taking our own lives.」

347:t_1:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Please wait! If you did that, everything the Prince did would be for nothing!」

347:t_1:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「In that case, you would only be making that person's life-risking actions meaningless.」

347:t_1:9.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Commander $$マルグリット$$ said the same thing you're saying now.」

347:t_1:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「So we cast aside the name and pride of knights, and decided to live on the soil of this Mars together with the people of $$インサラウム$$, even if it means living in shame.」

347:t_1:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We also apologize to you deeply for what happened back then.」

347:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Please, raise your heads. ...At least some of those here have no right to condemn you.」

347:t_1:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I did the same thing as Prince $$ユーサー$$, and yet I shamelessly live on in disgrace...」

347:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and I both know full well that we live in disgrace. Even so, we go on living now so that we can do what must be done.」

347:t_1:16.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...So you are the same as us.」

347:t_1:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You have already made your atonement. You must not forget to regret the past, but neither must you throw away the future.」

347:t_1:19.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Also, on behalf of our people, allow us to thank you for your condolences for our Prince.」

347:t_1:20.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...By the way, isn't $$マルグリット$$, the commander of the settlers, on Mars?」

347:t_1:24.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$クロウ$$, haven't you been in contact with $$マルグリット$$?」

347:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Listen, $$モーム$$... I told you I was on $$翠の地球$$ the whole time.」

347:t_1:26.en:
$$モーム$$
「If you had been on $$蒼の地球$$, would you have been in contact?」

347:t_1:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ugh... I poked the bush and out came an anaconda...」

347:t_1:28.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$$クロウ$$... Lady $$マルグリット$$ is the hope of $$インサラウム$$, and a sanctuary that must not be violated.」

347:t_1:29.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「No matter that you were the Prince's rival and someone he acknowledged, if you behave improperly toward her...」

347:t_1:30.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We, the men of $$インサラウム$$... are prepared to board the 《$$ディム・サー$$》 and fight again.」

347:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Those $$インサラウム$$ machines... are they still around?」

347:t_1:32.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We are part of the $$地球連邦軍$$ now too, so we use mobile suits for regular duties.」

347:t_1:33.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「However, with the approval of the Federation Assembly, we were also permitted to keep the $$ディム・サー$$ as part of preserving our culture.」

347:t_1:34.en:
$$ノイン$$
「The $$連邦政府$$ did something stylish for once.」

347:t_1:35.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We are grateful to the government, and at the same time, if the pride of $$インサラウム$$ is ever defiled, we intend to fight again in the $$ディム・サー$$.」

347:t_1:36.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Understood. ...Well, there's nothing between $$マルグリット$$ and me that you need to worry about.」

347:t_1:37.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$マルグリット$$, huh? I saw her in the files, and she's a super-hot lady knight, right? If it were me, I'd dive in wearing nothing but my underwear.)

347:t_1:38.en:
$$デュオ$$
(Guys who come on that hard like you are a problem, but $$クロウ$$'s spinelessness makes me sigh too...)

347:t_1:39.en:
$$カレン$$
「So... where is $$マルグリット$$ now?」

347:t_1:40.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The Commander should be on Earth right now.」

347:t_1:41.en:
$$スザク$$
「...Should be...? Have you not heard from her?」

347:t_1:43.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「But we believe the Commander is safe. She is the last $$ハイナイト$$, the one who kept our hopes alive.」

347:t_1:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Then I will get to the main subject. We would like you to tell us what you know about the current state of $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

347:t_1:45.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「While advancing the terraforming, we were also surveying this Mars, which was reconstructed by the $$新世時空震動$$.」

347:t_1:46.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「And then, when a new fusion of worlds occurred due to the destruction of the $$時の牢獄$$, a new enemy appeared on this Mars as well.」

347:t_1:47.en:
$$桂$$
「The way you put it... sounds like they are separate from the $$サイデリアル$$.」

347:t_1:48.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. They were a group of Earthling origin.」

347:t_1:49.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「While Earth was under attack by the $$サイデリアル$$, we were fighting that enemy here as well.」

347:t_1:50.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Sounds like you had it rough too.」

347:t_1:51.en:
$$カトル$$
「What became of the fight with that enemy?」

347:t_1:52.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Well... we were locked in a standoff, but somebody destroyed the enemy's home base, and the fighting ended.」

347:t_1:54.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The battle took place inside a magnetic storm, so we don't know the details.」

347:t_1:55.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That enemy called themselves 《$$メガノイド$$》. Does that ring a bell?」

347:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「No... I have never heard of them.」

347:t_1:58.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「At almost the same time those $$メガノイド$$ were wiped out, a gap in our surveillance was exploited and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$'s seal was broken.」

347:t_1:59.en:
$$五飛$$
「What is their connection to whoever defeated the $$メガノイド$$?」

347:t_1:60.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That is unknown. The garrison only saw a black machine flying away from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$... the $$シュロウガ$$.」

347:t_1:61.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We reported this matter to the $$地球連邦$$ right away, but...」

347:t_1:62.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So even the Federation was in no position to deal with the situation on Mars...」

347:t_1:63.en:
$$マオ$$
「Earth had its hands full dealing with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

347:t_1:64.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Unable to stand by any longer, Commander $$マルグリット$$ left for Earth herself as a $$メッセンジャー$$.」

347:t_1:65.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Sounds like she and we passed each other along the way.」

347:t_1:66.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then we'd like to investigate $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ourselves. Is that all right?」

347:t_1:67.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Understood. Leave supplies and the other arrangements to us.」

347:t_1:68.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「In particular, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ over there seems to have been pushed quite hard, so we will repair it thoroughly here.」

347:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks. I'm in your debt for everything.」

347:t_1:70.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Not at all... we are comrades now, so please don't hold back.」

347:t_1:71.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Besides, that $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ is also the mortal enemy of $$ジ・インサー$$, the treasure of $$インサラウム$$, and of His Highness.」

347:t_1:72.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We are in no position to ask this of you, but the late Prince's bitter regret...」

347:t_1:73.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I promise to do my best.」

347:t_1:74.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$ユーサー$$, are you watching...? The people you loved still love you to this day.)

347:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Your water jar never runs dry, and it keeps nourishing the people of $$インサラウム$$. So rest easy and leave the rest to us.)

347:t_1:82.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「To think there would be someone here.」

347:t_1:84.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I came to this red star of battle to confirm what becomes of fools in the end.」

347:t_1:85.en:
???
「The end of the $$メガノイド$$...? No... the $$クロノ$$ Reformists'?」
